answer: Each submission hangs on the voyage of a task receipt, and the wharf is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Reaching the canyon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
